about: Guesses an open-pass reviewer wrote and tested. A guess that held on several repos is a candidate kind.

guesses.guess: API error codes the server sends match the message.<code> ids the client looks up at run time.
guesses.perspective: New. message-ids checked only the static ids in messages.ts; these ids are built from response codes.
guesses.held: yes, recorded as api-error-message-ids
guesses.test: grep for code: literals and badRequest/unauthorized/forbidden/notFound/serverError calls under src/app/api and src/lib; a Python check of each code against the message section of all 52 files in public/intl/messages.

guesses.guess: Each translation's ICU argument names match en-US and the values each call passes.
guesses.perspective: New. public/intl had 1 of 158 files opened.
guesses.held: yes, recorded as message-argument-names
guesses.test: Python ICU argument parser over all 52 message files (an apostrophe quotes only before { } # | < > or another apostrophe; plural branch bodies are skipped), compared per key with en-US; plus a scan of every t(labels.X, {...}) and t.rich(messages.X, {...}) call in src for the keys passed. All 28 calls with values pass what en-US needs.

guesses.guess: Every path and method the client calls has a route file that exports the method.
guesses.perspective: New. Earlier passes checked only the report paths.
guesses.held: yes, recorded as client-api-route-paths
guesses.test: Python: list src/app/api/**/route.ts with exported methods, convert [x] segments to wildcards, and match every get/post/put/del/useUpdateQuery/useDeleteQuery path literal in src. 103 calls; the 4 calls with nested templates (FunnelEditForm, GoalEditForm, CohortEditForm, SegmentEditForm) were checked by hand.

guesses.guess: Every internal link target (href, router.push, renderUrl, nav path) has a page.tsx.
guesses.perspective: New.
guesses.held: partly. No live drift, so the team rewrite is recorded as team-url-prefix with no drift. The /reports tab in src/app/(main)/websites/[websiteId]/WebsiteTabs.tsx:40 has no page, but nothing imports that file.
guesses.test: Python: page.tsx routes with route groups, @slots and (.) intercepts stripped, the /teams/:teamId/:path* rewrite and the redirects in next.config.ts applied, matched against string targets in src.

guesses.guess: Each delete and reset path removes every table keyed to the entity, as the confirmation texts say.
guesses.perspective: New: cascade lists against prisma/schema.prisma relations.
guesses.held: yes, recorded as entity-delete-cascade
guesses.test: grep for deleteMany, delete( and updateMany in src/queries/prisma and src; the schema relation lists; grep for ALTER TABLE and DELETE FROM in src for ClickHouse deletes (none found).

guesses.guess: Web vitals thresholds, units and column precision are repeated and differ.
guesses.perspective: Deeper look at web-vitals-metrics, which checked metric names only.
guesses.held: no. WEB_VITALS_THRESHOLDS (constants.ts:105) is the only threshold source; cls is Decimal(10,4) and the others Decimal(10,1) in schema.prisma, migration 18, schema.sql and ClickHouse migration 09; the tracker sends milliseconds.
guesses.test: grep for the threshold numbers, lcp|inp|cls|fcp|ttfb across prisma, db and src.

guesses.guess: CSS module class names used in TSX exist in the imported .module.css.
guesses.perspective: New. The scan never reads .css files.
guesses.held: no. All 4 importers use only existing classes.
guesses.test: Python: for each import X from './Y.module.css', compare X.name and X['name'] uses with the class selectors in Y.

guesses.guess: Links to files in public/ carry BASE_PATH.
guesses.perspective: Deeper look at public-url-base-path, which checked shown URLs only.
guesses.held: yes, recorded as an extension of public-url-base-path
guesses.test: grep for /intl, /images, /datamaps, /favicon, /site.webmanifest, /script.js, /recorder.js and /telemetry.js in src, and the icon paths in public/site.webmanifest and public/browserconfig.xml.

guesses.guess: The date range values the pickers write are values the parsers read, on the server as in the browser.
guesses.perspective: New vocabulary.
guesses.held: yes; the vocabulary agrees, and cohort ranges resolve without the viewer's timezone; recorded as date-range-values
guesses.test: Read DateFilter, UnitFilter, WebsiteDateFilter, useDateRange, parseDateValue, parseDateRange, getAllowedUnits, request.ts and CohortEditForm; checked each UnitFilter unit against getAllowedUnits for its range by hand.

guesses.guess: The session and visit id derivation is copied into the pixel, link, batch or record routes.
guesses.perspective: New copied-helper.
guesses.held: no. Only the send route derives ids (send/route.ts:144-173); the pixel, link and batch routes call its POST, and record reads the cache token.
guesses.test: grep sessionSalt, visitSalt, uuid(sourceId and startOfHour in src.

guesses.guess: The recorder's payload matches the record route schema.
guesses.perspective: Deeper look at session-cache-token, which covered the token only.
guesses.held: no. {type: 'record', payload: {website, events, timestamp}} matches record/route.ts:18-25, and batches of 100 (recorder/index.js:28) fit max(200).
guesses.test: Read src/recorder/index.js and src/app/api/record/route.ts.

guesses.guess: Replay chunks are encoded by the writer the way the reader decodes them on each backend.
guesses.perspective: New.
guesses.held: no. Postgres stores gzip of JSON and the reader gunzips; ClickHouse stores JSON text and the reader parses it; ClickHouse dates come back as ISO (date_time_output_format iso, clickhouse.ts:281).
guesses.test: Read saveRecording.ts, getReplayChunks.ts and the session_replay table in db/clickhouse/schema.sql.

guesses.guess: The two pagedRawQuery copies return the same page shape.
guesses.perspective: New copied-helper.
guesses.held: no. They differ only in a search field that DataGrid reads as a fallback. No route accepts orderBy (sortingParams is in no route), so the interpolated order by takes no request input.
guesses.test: Read prisma.ts:285-332 and clickhouse.ts:238-263; grep sortingParams under src/app/api.

guesses.guess: Browser storage keys are written and read under different names.
guesses.perspective: New.
guesses.held: no. The keys come from constants.ts:2-10; share:navCollapsed and the tab keys are used in one file each; umami.disabled has no writer in the app.
guesses.test: grep for 'umami.' string literals, localStorage and getItem/setItem/removeItem in src.

guesses.guess: Run-time label lookups (labels[x]) use keys that exist.
guesses.perspective: New.
guesses.held: no. Units, ratings, role keys, vitals, device types and the 25 expanded-view types all exist in labels.
guesses.test: Python: list the label keys in src/components/messages.ts and the type props passed to MetricsTable and the expanded views.

guesses.guess: Cypress selectors, texts and paths match the components and pages.
guesses.perspective: New. Earlier passes opened five of the six specs for config and fixture seams (default-admin-account, role-names, cypress-container-mounts) and recorded no selector or path check.
guesses.held: yes, recorded as e2e-test-selectors
guesses.test: Python: every getDataTest('x') value in cypress/ against data-test="x" attributes in src; cy.visit paths against page routes.

guesses.guess: Every writer of event_data and session_data uses one string_value format per data type.
guesses.perspective: New, a value with several writers.
guesses.held: yes, recorded as event-data-value-format
guesses.test: grep data_type, dataType and DATA_TYPE in src, scripts and db; read src/lib/data.ts and scripts/seed/generators/events.ts.

guesses.guess: The 'path' and 'event' action types mean the same event filter in goals, attribution, funnels and cohorts.
guesses.perspective: Deeper look at event-type-codes, whose drift named journeys and realtime only.
guesses.held: yes, recorded as an extension of event-type-codes
guesses.test: grep for 'path' and event_type in src/queries/sql/reports and the cohort builders in src/lib/prisma.ts and src/lib/clickhouse.ts.

guesses.guess: share_type codes agree between the constants, the migration and the routes.
guesses.perspective: New vocabulary.
guesses.held: yes, with drift in the generic route; recorded as share-type-codes
guesses.test: grep shareType, share_type and ENTITY_TYPE in src and prisma/migrations.

guesses.guess: The /api/config fields match what useConfig's readers read.
guesses.perspective: New contract.
guesses.held: no. The route and the Config type list the same fields; currentVersion is returned but never read.
guesses.test: Read src/app/api/config/route.ts and grep config?. and useConfig() in src.

guesses.guess: The podman README steps match the files they name.
guesses.perspective: New. The scan skips .service files.
guesses.held: no. env.sample, podman-compose.yml, umami.service paths and the install script agree with podman/README.md.
guesses.test: Read podman/README.md, podman/umami.service and podman/install-systemd-user-service.

guesses.guess: The stale-issues exempt labels match the labels the issue templates apply.
guesses.perspective: New.
guesses.held: not recorded. The templates apply no labels, so bug and enhancement exemptions depend on triage; this has no code effect.
guesses.test: grep labels in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.yml and .github/workflows/stale-issues.yml.

guesses.guess: Context for ties: does CI type-check the app?
guesses.perspective: Affects every 'TypeScript would catch it' claim.
guesses.held: no. next.config.ts:201-203 sets typescript.ignoreBuildErrors: true, and ci.yml runs only jest and next build, so type errors outside jest-imported files fail no check.
guesses.test: Read next.config.ts and .github/workflows/ci.yml.
